title: Transfers Out of a Wanderlane Traveller Club Card
content:
Points leave one Wanderlane Traveller Club card and arrive on another only where the tier held permits transfers, in whole thousands, at or above the tier's minimum and within the tier's annual ceiling. Whole thousands means the quantity transferred is a multiple of 1000 points. The annual ceiling is read as the largest total that may go out of the card in one calendar year, so transfers already made in that calendar year count against it.

A transfer out is recorded only when no transfer carrying the same partner reference has already been recorded on this membership. The reference the member gives is checked against the transfers already recorded on this same membership; where one of them already carries that reference, this is not a fresh transfer.

The transfer fee is charged per thousand points to the member sending them, and is never taken out of the points themselves: the quantity that arrives on the receiving card is the quantity sent, and the fee is collected from the sender in money.

## Every condition must hold together

| Tier permits transfers | A multiple of 1000 points | At or above the tier's minimum | Within the tier's annual ceiling | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | yes | yes | The points may leave the card |
| no | yes | yes | yes | The points do not leave the card |
| yes | no | yes | yes | The points do not leave the card |
| yes | yes | no | yes | The points do not leave the card |
| yes | yes | yes | no | The points do not leave the card |

## Points of judgement

*A member on a tier that permits transfers asks to send a quantity that is not a multiple of 1000 points.* The quantity does not meet the whole-thousands condition, and the points do not leave the card on that quantity.

*A member sends a quantity equal to the tier's minimum exactly.* That quantity is at or above the minimum, and the condition is met.

*A member offers the same partner reference as one already recorded against a transfer on their membership.* A transfer out is recorded only when no transfer carrying the same reference has already been recorded on this membership.

*A member asks that the fee be taken from the points being sent.* The fee is charged per thousand points to the member sending them and is never taken out of the points themselves.
